# FINAL-INTEGRATION, 8 October 2026

Local build checks pass on the uncommitted `prod/compose` tree. This is not production verification or release approval. J15 still lacks dedicated operated acceptance for eight scenarios; the joined adapter refuses to invent passing evidence. No Git writes, push, package installation, real credential use, cloud API execution or published SQL changes occurred.

## 1. Migrations and SQL

Canonical platform chain is contiguous 1..58. J13 remains 53 and J5 remains 54; the unused J4 reservation closes: J14 56 -> 55, J3 57 -> 56, W5-GAPS 58 -> 57, J6 59 -> 58. Updated imports, tests, docs, canonical checksums, emitter grants and Supabase apply-table inventory. Regenerated only unpublished aggregate 0026 (cumulative 1..58, including new 44..58).

Compatibility approvals now cover contracts 49, 51, 57 and 58. Grant-only DO blocks 54..56 are classified by exact hashes. Custody remains SELECT/INSERT-only; MFA allows SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE without DELETE. The sensitive-data inventory already classified the new tables and passes. SQL scoping registers the authenticated token-hash lookup and the system-only managed revocation sweep, with an explicit caller/rebinding assertion. Immutable-AST caching removes repeated parser work; assertions and the 20-second deadline remain.

`git diff --numstat origin/codex/production-2026-10-02 -- supabase/migrations/001[6-9]* supabase/migrations/002[0-5]*` returned no changes.

## 2. Cross-job joins

J9 privileged consent delegates to J3 requireStepUp with verified subject, provider session and workspace. Central privileged route admission covers new runner updates and retention destinations; machine exceptions require verified transport, not header presence. Existing role/scope checks remain in handlers.

J1 exposes real up/down/private host env entry points, pinned Mailpit SMTP, Supabase TOTP enrollment and verification, and an owned Keycloak issuer on the same Docker network/CA trust/audience as the API and MCP. J2 enrolls both operators before privileged actions. J15 consumes actual J1 readiness/state and private J2 CLI receipt protocol; J4 runs in a child with the actual derived host environment and a private bounded maintenance overlay. It retains J1 server/port/credentials, binds all database authorities to the fresh database and requires an isolated j4-* namespace, a separate real API, pool 2 and serverless managed billing. Host pooler TLS uses its localhost SAN; J4 freshness checks remain intact. Covered J2 receipts are projected by a closed check inventory; unsupported scenarios stay skipped/incomplete.

L1/L2/L3 share a conservative locked budget book, exact ownership tag matcher, absence check and teardown helper. Budget reservations are not refunded. Unreadable/missing inventories cannot become empty inventories. Lambda live invocation now requires root scope and observed run-tag authorization before Invoke. Native fixture image checks refuse missing pins or wrong architecture. Local PostgreSQL and kind reuse existing J11 pins.

## 3. Registries and records

Canonical gate manifest exposes additive owner-run Wave 6 lanes, without enabling credentials or live gates. The literal inventory covers 213 test files, 178 contract files and 307 required gated identities. Three disabled informational notices have no assertion body and are classified separately; their real engine cases remain mandatory. Exact ancestry and stable case names survive environment-specific skip annotations. Strict validators reject missing, skipped, wrong-title and failed evidence. Existing CI lanes and their requirements remain. Shared critical-job, action, bearer-path, event sentence, route coverage, SQL and sensitive-data registry tests pass.

All 61 touched pending rows remain `implementation_complete_verification_pending`; no state/evidence promotion or release flag change. REQUIREMENTS regenerated. VERIFY-QUEUE adds Wave 6 per-requirement command plans; all 61 corresponding verify docs link exact argv/gates/strict report commands. PROGRESS and LIMITATIONS record current boundaries. The owner live runbook consolidates AWS/cloud/managed instructions; old URLs link to it.

## 6. Justified expectation changes and deviations

- Migrations/table inventories, last-version assertions and compat classification changed to the authorized contiguous 1..58 source. Grant-only/expand classification is exact-hash-bound; no assertion deleted.
- MFA route tests now model current verified AAL2 claims, live factor state and default workspace policy; mutation requests include actual same-origin headers. Old browser-only error labels preempted by shared step-up now assert the current message/status. Demo remains unavailable (503), signed-out real auth remains 401; denial/replay/tenant assertions remain.
- Hosted login doubles now carry the required browser nonce cookie. Sign-in links assert the app-bound launch URL, missing nonce asserts invalid_input, and tamper/replay/cross-host cases retain actual denial checks.
- Operator docs assert 17 current MCP tools, the workspace-state hash and actual source syntax. Supply-chain assertions require the J11-pinned Go/distroless bases instead of stale tag-only expectations. Native function graph defaults are preserved; J15 economics explicitly selects/prices only its container-equivalent fixture.
- Kubernetes system RBAC identifiers are classified as subjects while explicit image fields still reject them. The nonresolving registry.invalid source bootstrap sentinel gets one exact counted exception, with source custody replacing it before execution; it is not a runnable image fallback.
- Stripe fixture changes from unpinned v0.197.0 to publisher-native pinned v0.203.0; PostgreSQL changes from unpinned 16.6 to existing J11-pinned 16.15, and kind uses J11's pinned node. These are local disposable fixtures, Mac execution pending.
- J15 full operated-scenario coverage was not completed. The implementation makes the supported joins executable and incomplete cases explicit; this is the material remaining deviation from the requested push-ready completeness.

Publisher pin references: [LocalStack](https://hub.docker.com/layers/localstack/localstack/4.8.1/images/sha256-08e57a2147bda1ae1b21c0b571b410ea38a855b0ba4f8b2e2fa2d3a247dc3d2b), [CoreDNS](https://hub.docker.com/layers/coredns/coredns/1.12.4/images/sha256-d86c83e95bd44f145f52dc37a1f3bdcb9cb910d76c2653b5910ccbb7b7987d64), [Pebble 2.8.0](https://github.com/letsencrypt/pebble/pkgs/container/pebble/versions?filters%5Bversion_type%5D=tagged), [Stripe publisher tags](https://hub.docker.com/r/stripe/stripe-mock/tags), [Mailpit](https://hub.docker.com/layers/axllent/mailpit/v1.27/images/sha256-dfee4d1761c75364cda301eba86eeaed06117cfd5c67b56c4cf8c52013da9d4c).
